rules: Resolve the target module by course slug plus module slug; never hardcode generated module UUIDs in a future migration.
Require exactly one target module and assert sequence 2 and the target lesson slug are unused before any insert.
Insert the lesson initially with is_published=false, then attach reviewed sources and six terms only after a separate explicit database-write decision.
Do not create user progress, mastery, Error Bank, review or audio rows as part of curriculum publication.
Run authored-content, source and application regression checks before any separate is_published=true decision.
Recheck current-sensitive official sources at publication time, especially Irish payroll guidance.
Never set a P1 lesson is_published=true until interactivePublicationGate is fully satisfied for that exact lesson identity.
English P1 must never fall back to the current Golden Lesson identity or reference when resolving Professor persistence or teaching context.

requiredBeforeIsPublishedTrue: The exact P1 lesson identity resolves a reviewed server-authored Professor reference before any reservation or paid provider call.
Professor teacher and evaluator receive the same P1-specific reviewed lesson reference; browser drafts, local quiz answers and hints remain excluded.
English P1 persists and evaluates against its own published lesson identity and cannot silently resolve to the current English Golden Lesson.
P1 Audio/Professor provider paths use the reviewed budget, duplicate-generation and reconciliation controls applicable at publication time.
Executable mocked-handler and browser regressions prove the exact-lesson handoff, fail-closed behaviour and account boundaries before publication.
interactivePublicationGate.currentClientBoundary: If a reviewed P1 appears in the catalog before this gate is satisfied, written self-study may render but Audio and Professor providers are not mounted and the UI reports the gate explicitly.
interactivePublicationGate.notAuthorization: This gate documents prerequisites only. It is not authorization to deploy server changes, publish a lesson, write Supabase data or spend on provider acceptance.

publicationDecision: Explicit and separate. This plan is not authorization to write to Supabase or to publish the lessons.
